narration: A failing test. The attention badge on the graph immediately flags the problem - no scrolling through logs.
One click on Why reveals the full causal trace: the failed shell command, its error output, and the retry that followed.
Natural language search: type failed tools and jump straight to the failing command.
The inspector shows the exact tool call, its input, and the error - all without leaving the map.
The diff widget reveals the agent's first attempt: extending token lifetime instead of fixing the store write.
Switch to hierarchy layout to see the delegation structure - the subagent that found the root cause.
The subagent trace shows it read the session and store code, then identified the missing write-back.
Copy a permalink in one click - your teammate opens the map at this exact node and layout.
